milestone: Native CPU array/tensor main results and checked display

implementation.synchronous_entry: Owned ranked main descriptor returned by checked C wrapper, using the declared function signature when present
implementation.task_entry: Private void(output,invocation) collection wrapper clears active descriptor before execution and copies only successful owned task output
implementation.metadata: Private revisioned element/rank/array globals; one generic descriptor entry through rank 128
implementation.display: Validates full owned contiguous payload range, retains allocation lease, settles invocation owners, then formats without payload copying
implementation.format: Arrays as lists; tensors as flat row-major values plus complete shape; exact decimal integers, nine/17 significant float digits; default 100 elements, --limit N and --all

contract.memory: No borrowed/invalid descriptor output; retained backing survives context/root worker cleanup; no new payload copy in display
contract.errors: Checked allocation/shape/arithmetic/bounds/task errors produce existing stderr and no collection stdout
contract.scope: Completed CPU collections; scalar/Bool formatting unchanged; scheduler rank restrictions remain unchanged
contract.limits: Display rank bound matches default frontend 128; output truncation is explicit and adjustable, not a collection-size constraint
contract.ABI: Private executable interface, not stable C/C++ library or wire ABI

scope: Generated array/tensor main entries for six numeric types, annotated and inferred results, scalar tensors, dynamic conditional array lengths/tensor shapes and empty shapes
Exact signed/unsigned 32/64-bit endpoints; float32/float64 precision and signed zero; display-unit raw subnormal/max-finite/infinity/NaN bits remain unchanged
Pure CPU rank 0/8/9/128 formatting and generated empty high-rank executables; worker rank-zero values and empty array/rank-three outputs
Imported direct workers with cached awaits and post-group returns for all six numeric types; 1/2/4 workers, retained results after root/invocation settlement and recovered task errors
Guarded private ABI descriptors: untouched canaries/inactive suffix, cleared active prefix on allocation/admission failure, exact values after context cleanup; root observation allocation sweeps

Full-payload validation before bounded display: unknown backing, offsets/alignment, negative dimensions, count/byte overflow, noncanonical strides, unsupported element/rank/category and settled/faulted invocations rejected
Default 100-element truncation, --all/--limit including zero, invalid/overflowing/conflicting options rejected before program execution
Worker allocation-failure positions 1-8, checked Shape/Arithmetic/Bounds/task failures, no partial stdout and balanced context owner cleanup

Existing syntax/semantic/collection/numeric/control frontends, local module frontend/debug checks, source/task/recovery/storage/continuations, representative collection runtime and selected Metal regressions; focused qualification, not a full-suite claim

remaining_gates: GPU/mixed-target collection main results and explicit transfer/display integration
General printing effects, record/string display and program input arguments
Public native object/static/shared-library ABI and packaging
